name: Neon
headline: Custom Neon Signs for Bright, Classic Visibility
shortDescription: Neon signs and accents for storefronts, windows, interiors, borders, and illuminated display work.
body: Neon signs are used when a business wants a bright, memorable sign that is visible during the day and at night.
Applications include main front signs, window signs, interior signs, border accents, and complementary lighting for existing storefront signs.

image.alt: Bright neon sign glowing in a storefront window.
